relationships.subject: tBHQ
relationships.evidence_quote: mRNA levels of NRF2 and HO-1 were increased in the T0 group [40 µmol/l tBHQ treatment] compared with the control group, which indicated that tBHQ activated the NRF2 signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: ozone
relationships.evidence_quote: 40 µg/ml ozone induced death of SCNs in vitro, and mRNA and protein levels of HO-1 decreased with higher concentrations of ozone (30 and 40 µg/ml).

relationships.subject: tBHQ
relationships.evidence_quote: Conversely, a decrease in necrosis and increase in live cells was observed in the T40 group compared with the 40 µg/ml ozone group.

key_findings: High-dose ozone (40 ug/ml) decreased NRF2, HO-1, p62, LC3II and nuclear NRF2 in spinal cord neurons and increased necrosis.
NRF2 activator tBHQ reversed these changes and protected neurons in vitro.
